title: Definitions
description: Defines key procedural terms used in the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, including cognizable offence, complaint, investigation, inquiry and police report.

title: When police may arrest without warrant
description: Specifies circumstances in which a police officer may arrest a person without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant.

title: Procedure of arrest and duties of officer
description: Lays down safeguards and procedure while making arrest, including identification and informing grounds of arrest.

title: Designated police officer and recording information
description: Requires transparency and recording obligations in relation to arrests and detention management.

title: Right of arrested person to meet advocate
description: Provides that an arrested person is entitled to meet an advocate of his choice during interrogation, though not throughout interrogation.

title: Search of place entered by person sought to be arrested
description: Authorizes police to enter and search premises where a person to be arrested is believed to be present.

title: Examination of arrested person by medical practitioner
description: Permits medical examination of arrested person in specified circumstances for evidence collection and safety.

title: Person arrested not to be detained beyond twenty-four hours
description: No police officer shall detain in custody a person arrested without warrant for more than twenty-four hours without Magistrate authorization.

title: Police to report apprehensions
description: Requires reporting of arrests without warrant to District Magistrate or Sub-divisional Magistrate.

title: Search and seizure
description: Provides procedural framework for search, seizure, and recording, including grounds, witnesses and inventory.
chapter: Chapter VIII - Processes to Compel Production

title: Recording of search and seizure through electronic means
description: Encourages or mandates use of audio-video or electronic recording for procedural transparency.
chapter: Chapter VIII - Processes to Compel Production

title: Information in cognizable cases
description: Mandates registration of information relating to commission of cognizable offences and procedural handling by police station.

title: Procedure for investigation
description: Sets rules for investigation, including collection of evidence, statements, and case diary standards.

title: Statements to police
description: Provides framework for examination of witnesses by police during investigation and evidentiary limitations.

title: Completion of investigation and police report
description: Requires filing of police report upon completion of investigation with details of parties, facts and collected evidence.

title: Supply to accused of police report and other documents
description: Accused is entitled to copies of police report, statements and relied-upon documents before trial.

title: Discharge
description: Court may discharge accused if charge is groundless after considering record and submissions.
chapter: Chapter XVII - Trial Before Court of Session

title: Framing of charge
description: Court frames charge when there is ground for presuming that the accused committed an offence triable by the court.
chapter: Chapter XVII - Trial Before Court of Session

title: Procedure where accused is not convicted
description: Specifies consequences and procedural outcomes when prosecution fails to prove case.
chapter: Chapter XVIII - Trial of Warrant Cases

title: Judgment
description: Prescribes requirements for pronouncement and content of criminal judgment.

title: Appeal from conviction
description: Details right and procedure of appeal against conviction and sentence.

title: Power to suspend or remit sentences
description: Appropriate Government may suspend execution of sentence or remit punishment under prescribed conditions.

title: Maximum period for undertrial detention
description: Addresses release of undertrial prisoners after specified period of detention relative to maximum sentence.

title: Trial and proceedings held in electronic mode
description: Enables use of electronic and digital means in criminal proceedings, including summons, service, and hearings where permitted.
